caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular piece of cloth or textile with a yellow background, featuring an embroidered or textured floral pattern. The cloth appears slightly rounded at the edges and is placed against a light grayish-blue background. The design consists of several flowers in various colors: a pink flower with white edges in the upper left, an orange flower with a white center in the upper right, a larger central flower with mixed shades of pink, green, and white, another flower in the lower left in pale pink and white, and a white flower with an orange center in the lower right. Some leaves and stems in tones of yellow, green, and orange extend around and between the flowers, forming a loosely connected composition across the surface of the cloth. The overall texture shows visible lines, resembling stitched embroidery or cross-hatching, and the colors appear soft and muted.
title: Crewel Embroidery
